name: BANDAI NAMCO Holdings Inc.
summary: BANDAI NAMCO Holdings Inc. develops entertainment-related products and services worldwide. It operates in four segments: Digital Business, Toys and Hobby Business, Video and Music Business, and Amusement Business. The company offers toys, capsule toys, cards, confectionery and foods, apparel, sundries, plastic models, prizes, stationery, and other products.
